Contracts.Title: Bounty: {count} {species}
Contracts.Brief: Tracks along the supply road. {count} {species}, by the look of them, hunting in {place}. Bring back teeth.

Contracts.Title: Cull: {count} {species}
Contracts.Brief: Snow Hollows keep drifting toward the gate. Thin out {count} of them in {place} before they find the braziers.

Contracts.Title: A rogue {species}
Contracts.Brief: A {species} has gone rogue near {place} and dives at every sledge. Old Whitecrest won't miss it. Neither will the sledge drivers.

Contracts.Title: Walk a scout to {dest}
Contracts.Brief: A green scout needs to reach {dest} in one piece. Snow Hollows love green scouts. Don't let them have this one.
Contracts.Name: Warden scout

Contracts.Title: Supply run to {dest}
Contracts.Brief: Lamp oil, jerky and one very important flask of coffee. Get it to {dest} before the coffee gives up.

Contracts.Title: Close a rift in {place}
Contracts.Brief: The static spiked over {place}. There's a tear there, leaking {species}. Find its heart and break it.

Contracts.Title: A mirror rift in {place}
Contracts.Brief: Something is stepping out of a tear in {place} wearing other people's faces. Close it before somebody's mother comes home twice.

Contracts.Title: Shade hunt: {count} {species}
Contracts.Brief: {count} {species} are feeding on the dead frequencies in {place}. Open the Eye and clear them out.

Contracts.Title: Behind the Veil: {species}
Contracts.Brief: A {species} has wandered too close to the Veil over {place}. Cross over and put it down before it wanders through.

Contracts.Title: Tuning fork for {dest}
Contracts.Brief: A tuning fork that hums on the dead frequency needs to reach {dest}. It also attracts shades. Walk fast.

Contracts.Title: Salvage: {species}
Contracts.Brief: A {species} is sitting on good stone in {place}. Break it and bring the pieces home. Dante pays by the pound.

Contracts.Title: Pest control: {count} {species}
Contracts.Brief: {count} {species} are chewing through a job site in {place}. Squash them and sweep up the dust.

Contracts.Title: Trophy: {species}
Contracts.Brief: Dante wants drake plate. The drake wants to keep it. One of you is going to be disappointed in {place}.

Contracts.Title: Rush parts to {dest}
Contracts.Brief: A crate of fresh-forged parts for {dest}. They're still hot. Don't sit on them.

Contracts.Title: Apprentice to {dest}
Contracts.Brief: One of Dante's apprentices has a quote to deliver at {dest}. The jackals smell the forge on her. Keep her in one piece.
Contracts.Name: Apprentice smith

Contracts.Title: Patient to {dest}
Contracts.Brief: A patient needs to reach {dest}, and something out there is hungry. Keep them breathing. Mara will check.
Contracts.Name: Patient

Contracts.Title: Medicine to {dest}
Contracts.Brief: A box of medicine for {dest}. It keeps for five minutes once it leaves the cold, and Mara is counting.

Contracts.Title: Jackal cull: {count} {species}
Contracts.Brief: {count} {species} have been stalking the night shift in {place}. Make the walk home safe again.

Contracts.Title: Seal a tear in {place}
Contracts.Brief: Patients from {place} keep coming in with the same violet nightmares. There's a tear there. Close it so they can sleep.
